comment: Checked-in documents under experiments/ that name an adapter the registry does not declare, so they cannot run against main. They are preserved history rather than defects: PR #139 deliberately preserved the ztok trials, and QWEN_CAPTION_DECLARATIVE_MIGRATION.md says the old bespoke implementation and its artifacts remain historical evidence. What was missing was anything mechanical linking that prose to the documents. This is a countdown, not a configuration. scripts/ci_experiment_adapter_gate.py FAILS when a listed document's adapters all resolve, so porting an implementation forces the entry's deletion; it also fails when a listed path no longer exists. Adding an entry is a deliberate act that says a new document cannot run -- prefer declaring the adapter.

documents.why: The Qwen caption bespoke trainer is not on origin/main -- `git log origin/main -- src/rwkv_lab/qwen_caption_finetune.py` returns nothing, so that path has never existed on main. The implementation is real but unmerged, reachable from `integration/parity-candidate` (1a906c9d). docs/experiment-vm/PRESERVED_WORKTREE_ARTIFACTS.md records this bundle with per-file content hashes. Delete this entry when the adapter is declared, not before.
